difficultyAxis: Top of tier 1: the widest trivial entity (five attributes, four Java types) and three scenarios across two stories, still with no relationship and no validation rule.
rationale: Deliberately the last blueprint that asks nothing of the generator beyond one flat entity. It sets the ramp into tier 2, where a second entity and a declared validation rule appear for the first time.

userStories.intent: save a bookmark with a url, a title and an optional folder
userStories.benefit: the link can be found again later

scenarios.given: a url, a title and no folder
scenarios.then: the bookmark is persisted with a null folder and returned with its identifier

scenarios.given: a url, a title and a folder name
scenarios.then: the bookmark is persisted with the folder it was given

userStories.benefit: the user can navigate to the stored link

scenarios.then: the bookmark is returned with its url and title
